category_edits.rationale: Switch all four category models to BERT-style post-norm Transformer blocks while retaining the final LayerNorm. This may improve masked-item representations. Embeddings, readout, loss, optimizer and training settings remain fixed. The generated predictor imports the same model class, preserving architecture and checkpoint consistency.

response.change_summary: Use post-norm bidirectional Transformer blocks across all four BERT4Rec models, preserving masked-target training and appended-mask inference.
